description:
Search approved galactic.inc newsroom items.

Call this for recent headlines about an asset, an issuer, or a topic. Items that are not approved are omitted. The response has no source URL.

JSON: {"matched", "items": [{id, date, category, headline, lede, assets}]}. assets is a list of tickers. date is YYYY-MM-DD. limit defaults to 8.

limit.description: Maximum items to return, from 1 to 30.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of headline, lede, category, or asset ticker. Empty returns the latest approved items.

response_format.description: markdown (default) is a compact reading form. json is the object described below, with source numbers and omitted fields left out.

name: search_news
